description: Search Hong Kong companies by Chinese/English name keyword or 7-digit CR number. Works WITHOUT an API key (15 free searches/day per IP; 50/day with free API key; 300/day for paid users). Returns matching list with legal names, CR number, active/dissolved status, incorporation date, and entity type.

api_key.description: Optional 86hc.com MCP API key (format: hkq_live_xxxx). Omit or leave empty to use the automatic Guest IP Trial Mode (3 free company detail queries/day + direct Stripe filing orders without a key). Free API key with 20 daily company queries available at https://www.86hc.com/user

limit.description: Max number of results to return (1-20, default 5).

query.description: Company name keyword (Chinese or English, min 2 chars) or CR number (1-7 digits).

name: search_companies
